data.description:
#Day Sail $560
#Sunset $655


50% is due at the time of booking. The remaining balance is due at the time of the charter.

##Departing Location

Boston Sailing Tours departure location is at Courthouse Docks, Located Across From Marcelino's Seaport - 2 Northern Ave, Boston, MA 02210. All trips will depart from this location. Paid public parking is available.
[MAP] (https://maps.app.goo.gl/gHTdWAB4SDhYSsPQ6)

##Duration

2 Hours

##About

Spectacular views of the Boston Harbor skyline, a very relaxing sailing experience for your special event. The perfect stage for a unique moment… Birthdays, proposals, memorials, or simply cruising along.

This is a complete tour of the inner harbor. You will sail by the USS Constitution, the North End, the Seaport District, Castle Island, and East Boston.

##What to Bring

CONSIDER TO BRING
Sailors should dress for safety, comfort, and weather. In spring and fall, dress in layers and bring a jacket or sweatshirt; it can be cooler at sea than on land.

In summer, bring a hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen. 

For safety and comfort, soft-soled shoes like boat shoes or sneakers are the preferred footwear aboard the Francesca. You will be asked to go barefoot for safety reasons if you wear hard-soled shoes or high heels on board.

##What Not To Bring
'Per Federal regulation no marijuana or marijuana-containing products no illicit drugs

##Food, Drinks, Music

• You’re welcome to bring your favorite food, drinks, and music.
• We recommend easy-to-eat items and canned drinks. 
• We do not have a formal table in the cockpit
• We have complimentary water and sodas on board

[FULL GUEST INFORMATION](https://www.bostonsailtours.com/2-hour-harbor-sail)

data.cancellation_notes:
##BOOKING RESERVATION:

50% IS DUE AT BOOKING. THE REMAINING BALANCE DUE AT THE TIME OF CHARTER

##CANCELLATION POLICY:

• 48 hours prior to the charter, You will receive a full refund minus 10% of the total value of the trip.
• Less than 48 hours, No refund is available
• A no-show is considered a cancellation.
• If the trip is canceled by inclement weather, you have the choice to reschedule or get a refund.

##LIFE JACKET POLICY

• Boston Sailing Charters strongly recommends the use of our USCG-approved life jackets for all passengers while on board. We will provide a life jacket to any passenger wishing to wear one.
• Passengers twelve and under are required by law to wear life jackets while on the vessel.
Parents or guardians are responsible for determining if their minors between the ages of 13-17 must wear a life jacket.
The person booking the charter is required to share our life jacket policy with all members of their group.

##ALCOHOL/DRUG POLICY:

• Customers are welcome to bring beer or wine. No hard liquor. No red wine
• Per Federal regulation NO marijuana or marijuana-containing products. No illicit drugs

##ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS

• Infants and children, regardless of age, are included in the six-person maximum allowed on board. This is a requirement by the United State Coast Guard.
• Gift Certificates are non-refundable and are valid from the date purchased until October 31st of the following charter season.
data.booking_notes:
##BOOKING RESERVATION:

50% IS DUE AT BOOKING. THE REMAINING BALANCE DUE AT THE TIME OF CHARTER

##Weather Policy

We want you to have the best experience and will only sail in moderate conditions. Occasional light rain clouds wind and seas are part of the New England nautical weather experience. Only the captain based on his experience has the discretion to cancel a trip for inclement weather. You will be informed within 2 hours prior to the trip if there is any concern. If the trip is canceled by inclement weather, you have the choice to reschedule or get a full refund.

We reserve the right to cancel a trip for unforeseen circumstances, in this case, you will be fully refunded.

If you need to contact me, please call 617-279-3981

##What Should I Bring?

CONSIDER TO BRING
Sailors should dress for safety, comfort, and weather. In spring and fall, dress in layers and bring a jacket or sweatshirt; it can be cooler at sea than on land.

In summer, bring a hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen. 

For safety and comfort, soft-soled shoes like boat shoes or sneakers are the preferred footwear aboard the Francesca. You will be asked to go barefoot for safety reasons if you wear hard-soled shoes or high heels on board.

WHAT NOT TO BRING

Per Federal regulation no marijuana or marijuana-containing products, NO illicit drugs, NO hard liquor, NO red wine

##Children

Passengers twelve and under are required by law to wear life jackets while on the vessel.

Parents or guardians are responsible for determining if their minors between the ages of 13-17 must wear a life jacket.

##Food, Drinks, Music

• You’re welcome to bring your favorite food, drinks, and music.
• We recommend easy-to-eat items and canned drinks. 
• We do not have a formal table in the cockpit.
• We have complimentary water and sodas on board.

##Motion Sickness

It is very unlikely to get seasick on the harbor. If you think you are extra sensitive consider limiting your trip to the 2 hour Harbor sail 

##What If I'm Running Late

We will always wait for you. However, we will conclude your sail at the scheduled finishing time. If you are running late, please call 617-829-9555 to notify us as soon as possible.

##Pets & Tipping

• Pets are welcome aboard if they can sit on your lap at all times.
• Tips are graciously accepted.
